definitions: A cast bronze instrument of significant mass and wall thickness, hung in a tower and rung to announce the hour, the service, or the apocalypse, depending on parish.
colloq. What happens when a wind chime commits fully.
example: The bell swung once and the pigeons filed a collective complaint.
etymology: From Old English belle, of uncertain deeper origin, possibly imitative of the sound itself. Some words just give up trying to be clever.
caption: Plate CXXXIII., A cathedral bell of formidable bronze, mid-swing and entirely unconcerned with anyone's eardrums.
